party_basis: the last party primary each voter voted in (the 2026 primaries and May runoffs; Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties 2024-2026)

party_hints.cast: Everyone who has voted so far by the last party primary they voted in (the 2026 primaries and May runoffs; Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties 2024-2026), from the official rosters. No recent primary = none in that span, including new voters.
party_hints.mail_voted: Mail ballots received by the last party primary they voted in (the 2026 primaries and May runoffs; Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties 2024-2026), from the official rosters. No recent primary = none in that span, including new voters.
party_hints.early_voted: In-person early voters by the last party primary they voted in (the 2026 primaries and May runoffs; Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties 2024-2026), from the official rosters. No recent primary = none in that span, including new voters.

unk_label: counted, but not yet on the rosters
map_note: In-person early votes for 9 counties (Bell, Dallas, Ellis, Hays, Hockley, Madison, McLennan, Montgomery, Travis) come from the county's own live turnout page (updated through the day). Harris's in-person early votes come from the county's own early-voting report, posted each voting evening (ahead of the state's next-morning figure). Every other county's come from the Secretary of State's daily report, which adds each day's in-person votes the next morning, so during the day those counties lag behind. Party is the last party primary each voter voted in -- the 2026 primaries and May runoffs (Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties: 2024 and 2026) -- matched voter by voter from official rosters: every county's early-voting and mail voters from the Secretary of State's daily roster files (through Oct 27), and Harris County's from its own rosters, which run ahead; the 2026 primary and runoff voters from the state's rosters, and 2024's from Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties' own (2024's aren't available statewide, and no other county keeps them). Ballots not on the rosters yet, such as today's in-person votes, count as party not reported. 5,623,381 voters matched. Where a county's own early-voting and mail lists run ahead of the state's files, they are read too, a voter on both counting once: Bexar (its mail ballots aren't in the state's files), Collin, Dallas, Denton, El Paso, Fort Bend, Montgomery, Tarrant, Travis, Webb (the county hasn't reported to the state). Where the rosters count more mail or in-person voters than the state's report or a county's live page, the roster count is used for that method: Harris 781,941 (was 778,195), Dallas 505,754 (was 502,633), Tarrant 437,465 (was 422,698), Bexar 391,334 (was 389,734), Travis 357,635 (was 357,033), Collin 280,784 (was 279,093), Denton 245,293 (was 243,569), Fort Bend 204,429 (was 203,809).

source.primary: Texas Secretary of State, Election Information & Turnout Data (unofficial early voting turnout by county, as submitted by county election officials)

party_history.label: official rosters (Texas SoS daily voter files, Harris County rosters) matched to the 2026 (and in three counties 2024) primary rosters
